parts.text: I plan and run our flights, and as the licensed person responsible for each flight, I decide which drone flies and along which way, and I sign off a flight before it leaves. I can call off a flight, and several of us plan at the same time, often for the same busy sites and popular drones. Our policy is that software never chooses a drone or a way for us, but I want help finding out which of our drones could get to where a job starts.
